answer_1.quote: We propose the task of unsupervised morphological paradigm completion... we aim to construct and fill inflection tables exclusively from raw text and a lemma list for a known part of speech (POS)... Our system performs the following four steps: (i) EDIT TREE retrieval, (ii) additional lemma retrieval, (iii) paradigm size discovery using distributional information, and (iv) inflection generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated inflected word forms completing morphological paradigms

answer_2.quote: We propose to use best-match accuracy (BMAcc), the best accuracy among all mappings from pseudo-tags to paradigm slots, for evaluation.
